additional_info.subject: ID0481001-DC/Si-D/TR- [Y2 / S1 313508370002] Logs Check CRM:03289000659
additional_info.body:
Dear Rosita,
I hope this email finds you well.
Following the charge session on the charger, the big screenshot that I shared is the end report after every session ending.
On the screenshot we can see showing the outlet where the session was related, the EVMAC that was provided by the car. Apart from this, there you can see showing no "PLC Link" that means the car didn't shared more information.
Following the last highlight we can see the information shared by the car to the charger that is EVReady:0. For this reason we don't have any reason provided from the car to the charger for the authentication failed.
So regarding the charger we can have more information but the car didn't connected with the charger to give information.
With best regards
,
eMobility Technical Support Team – Felipe Moraes
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
